name: prompt-bar
title: Prompt bar
description: Where people write to an agent: attachments, model, voice and send.

props.name: value
props.description: The text. Pass it with onValueChange to control it.

props.name: attachments
props.description: Files shown as chips above the field; people can remove them before sending.

props.name: model
props.description: The selected model's value (or its label, when there is no `models` list).

props.name: models
props.description: The models menu. Without it the select shows `model` and opens nothing.

props.name: modelIcon
props.description: Icon on the select when `models` doesn't give one.

props.name: actions
props.description: Rows of the + menu. Defaults to Upload a file and Web search, in the `uploadFile` and `webSearch` labels.

props.name: onAddAgent
props.description: The + at the end of the menu's search row.
